cmbo_FcstType_family.SQL_NM: [C] AS-IS @Code='EndCustomerByDivision40' 수작업 통합 변환 — 빈 파라미터 0행 함정
cmbo_FcstType_family.SQL_DTL_CTN:
SELECT DISTINCT C.DEPT_ID, A.PROJECT_CODE AS CODE, NVL(D.SEGMENT3, A.PROJECT_CODE) AS NAME
FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO B ON B.USER_ID = TRIM(CASE WHEN INSTR(A.OWNER, ',') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(A.OWNER, 1, INSTR(A.OWNER, ',') - 1) ELSE A.OWNER END)
JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON C.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID
LEFT JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D ON A.DIVISION_ID = D.SEGMENT1 AND A.PROJECT_CODE = D.SEGMENT2 AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
UNION
SELECT NULL AS DEPT_ID, SEGMENT2, SEGMENT3 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'END_CUSTOMER' AND SEGMENT1 = '40' AND SEGMENT2 <> '-' AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY 2

SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME
FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE' AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ

cmbo_FcstType_family.SQL_NM: DMF0082 FCST Type 표시용 (division 전달 시 W/S 분기 — AS-IS UP_FX_GetCommonDataList_DM)
cmbo_FcstType_family.SQL_DTL_CTN:
SELECT CODE, NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ FROM (
  /* [E20260814-WSDIV] No.42 — 81 계열 + DM Planner(W/S) 만 SALES_TYPE_CODE2(W/S 4종) */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE2'
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') LIKE '81%'
  AND    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                 WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y')
  UNION ALL
  /* division 전달 + W/S 자격 아님 → SALES_TYPE_CODE 에서 W/S 전용(ATTRIBUTE2=Y) 2종만 제외 = 12종 */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(ATTRIBUTE2, ' ') <> 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') <> '-'
  AND    NOT ( NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') LIKE '81%'
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                           WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y') )
  UNION ALL
  /* division 미전달(메타 셀 콤보 = CODE->NAME 표시 매핑) → 전 코드 1행씩 (중복 없음) */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') = '-'
) ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ, CODE

cmbo_FcstType_family.SQL_NM: DMF0082 FCST Type 편집후보 (division × DM Planner(W/S) 분기)
cmbo_FcstType_family.SQL_DTL_CTN:
SELECT CODE, NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ FROM (
  /* [E20260814-WSDIV] No.42 — 81 계열 + DM Planner(W/S) → SALES_TYPE_CODE2 4종 */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE2'
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') LIKE '81%'
  AND    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                 WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y')
  UNION ALL
  /* 그 외(40 포함) → SALES_TYPE_CODE 에서 W/S 전용(ATTRIBUTE2=Y) 2종만 제외 = 12종(ETC 포함) */
  SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME, DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM   SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
  WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE'
  AND    VALID_YN = 'Y'
  AND    NVL(ATTRIBUTE2, ' ') <> 'Y'
  AND    NOT ( NVL(TRIM(@divisionId), '-') LIKE '81%'
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M G
                           WHERE G.USER_ID = @sesUserId AND G.USER_GR_ID = 'DM Planner (W/S)' AND G.USE_YN = 'Y') )
) ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ, CODE
SELECT SEGMENT1 AS CODE, SEGMENT2 AS NAME FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SALES_TYPE_CODE2' AND VALID_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY DISPLAY_SEQ
